remarks: Beautiful And Versatile Ranch Offering Three Bedrooms Or Two Bedrooms Plus A Family Room. Enter Through The New Front Door Into An Open Living Room Filled With Natural Light, Featuring A Textured Ceiling And Gleaming Laminate Flooring. The Interior Is Freshly Painted With Some Newer Light Fixtures. The Eat-In Kitchen Has A Walk-In Pantry And Sliding Glass Doors Leading To A Deck Overlooking A Tree-Lined, Park-Like Lot. The Full Bathroom Features A Bath Fitter Tub And Grab Bars. Two Bedrooms Have Hardwood Floors. The Spacious, Flexible Room With New Sliding Glass Doors Works As A Family Room, Den, Study, Guest Room, Or Primary Bedroom. Enter Through The Newer Two-Car Garage Door Into A Mudroom With Stairs Leading Up To The Main Level Or Down To A Full Basement. The Basement Includes A Full Bathroom, A Finished Recreation Room Or Storage Area With Closets, And A Laundry Area With Newer Washer And Dryer. Additional Updates Include New Electric Service, Some New Outlets, A Water Backup Sump Pump, Glass Block Windows, And A Workbench. Fantastic Location Near Errick Road Elementary, Stores, The Northtowns, And Buffalo. Seller’s Discretion On Day And Time For Reviewing Offers.
